Its powerful strikes are said to crush an opponent's body and resolve alike.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 52 |durability = 40 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Royal Claymore}} Royal Claymores are part of the [[Royal Gear]] series. They are two-handed [[Weapon]]s intended to be wielded by the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]] and the [[Royal Guard]]. Being struck by one of these Claymores is said to destroy one's body and their resolve. They have a base attack damage of 52. Royal Claymores are scattered throughout [[Hyrule]]. They can be found on the necklaces of [[Hinox]]es. [[Stalnox]] can also drop Royal Claymores when they are defeated, particularly the one within [[Lockup]]. Other high-tier enemies, such as [[Silver Moblin]]s, make use of them. Royal Claymores can also be found in the following locations: * [[Woodland Tower]] * [[Nero Hill]] * [[Hyrule Castle]] * Various [[Ancient Shrine]]s * Coliseum Ruins (If only three [[Divine Beast]]s have been completed) When the following [[amiibo]] are scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], they have a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Royal Claymore: * {{SSB}} Series [[Young Link]] amiibo * {{TLoZ Series}} Series [[Link]] ({{LA}}) amiibo If a Royal Claymore is equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]], it will attract [[Lightning]] due to being made of metal. Similarly, they are capable of conducting [[Electricity]]. They can also be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] Rune on the [[Sheikah Slate]], and they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. They are incapable of burning, which means they can be exposed to [[Fire]] and [[Scorching Climate]]s without issue.
